Hold A's outgoing ITEM_DETECTED, RESULT, or EXIT message at the runtime delivery boundary; test each channel separately.
Cancel A from the sidepanel, then start picker B without changing the browser tab or URL.
Deliver A's held message through the service worker's stamped rebroadcast while B is active.

For reinjection cleanup, inject a second content context, then click one card; require exactly one detection event and normal page clicking after the active picker closes.
